name: clay golem
desc: Clay Golem is a CR 9 construct.

actions.name: acid absorption
actions.desc: Whenever the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is subjected to &Reference[Acid] damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Acid damage dealt.

actions.name: berserk
actions.desc: Whenever the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} starts its turn &Reference[Bloodied], roll [[/r 1d6]]. On a 6, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} attacks an object. Once the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} goes berserk, it remains so until it is destroyed or it is no longer Bloodied.

actions.name: magic resistance
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes two [[/item Slam]] attacks, or it makes three Slam attacks if it used Hasten this turn.

actions.name: slam
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]], and the target's Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Acid damage taken.

actions.name: hasten
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes the &Reference[Dash] and &Reference[Disengage] actions.
